senses.gloss: f. (cmp. אִית a. אִישׁ; = h. אִשָּׁה; (cmp. אִנְתָּא) woman, wife.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 2:22">Targ. Gen. II, 22</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 5:3:12">Y. Maasr. V, end, 52ᵃ</cite> <he>חדא איתא</he> a certain woman.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:4:6">Y. Taan. I, 64ᵇ</cite> bot. <cite ref="A01641"><he>איתה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:8:9">Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>איתתֵיה דאבוהי</he> his father’s wife, step-mother (fig. for Babylon); a. fr.
